philippines.title: Asian Para Games: Ernie Gawilan adds silver to golden campaign
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines–Veteran para swimmer Ernie Gawilan added a silver medal to his medal haul at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games, finishing second in the men’s 200-meter individual medley SM7 final on Tuesday. Gawilan clocked 2 minutes, 52.72 seconds for his second podium finish in as many days, following his victory in the men’s 400-meter freestyle S7 that delivered the Philippines’ first gold medal of the Asian Para Games. China’s Zhang Yilong won the medley final in an Asian-record 2:37.69, while India’s Niranjan Mukundan claimed bronze in 2:57.01.
